Build prompt

Rebuild this interaction 1:1: Brilliant's course carousel - swiping horizontally between course pages (Solving Equations, Science Puzzles, Logic, Thinking in Code, Mathematical Thinking) re-themes the whole page: the 3D illustration, LEVEL badge, lesson list preview, page dots, and Start button all shift to each course's accent color.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
Light screen: course title + LEVEL 1 badge, a centered 3D illustration (balance scale, lightbulb puzzle piece, magnifier with check, code editor blocks, easel), a lesson list preview (two rows with Koji-avatar icons), page dots, a full-width Start button, and the bottom tab bar.

## Motion spec
Pattern: horizontal carousel with full-page re-theme.
- Swipe: pages track the finger 1:1 with neighbor pages peeking; release snaps to the nearest page (spring ~320/22, velocity-aware).
- Illustration swap: the outgoing 3D illustration slides with the page while the incoming one scales 0.9 -> 1 with a soft overshoot (spring ~300/16).
- Re-theme: accent color (badge, list highlights, page dot, Start button fill) cross-fades to the new course's hue (300ms) - blue, amber, purple, indigo variants.
- Content: lesson rows and title cross-fade/slide (200ms) after the page settles.

## Calibration
- The re-theme follows the swipe in progress, not after - tint interpolates with drag position.
- Keep the tab bar neutral; only the content area re-colors.

## Reduced motion
Swipe snaps without tracking (250ms ease-out); theme switches with a 200ms fade.

## Don't miss
- Each course has its own 3D illustration style; they never share artwork.
- The Start button color is the loudest accent - it must match the current course exactly.
